purpose: Record the materials actually available to Pass 5 and define how each may be used.

materials.name: AI (HD version).zip
materials.use: primary historical evidence for strategic archaeology and designer-logic reconstruction
materials.publication: derived analysis and small attributed contextual exhibits only; do not reproduce large contiguous source

materials.name: Promisory.zip
materials.use: provenance/context only where explicitly justified; not a strategic authority source
materials.publication: do not mirror source tree or large source excerpts

materials.name: AiBuilder.per
materials.use: tooling/context evidence for exposed configuration concepts such as phases, resource allocation, caps, prerequisites and infrastructure limits
materials.publication: small attributed exhibits only; never copy wholesale

evidence_policy: Historical source establishes what the historical implementation did. Stock tooling can establish what configuration concepts were exposed. Neither establishes that a generalized AEGIS principle is universally optimal. General principles require independent rationale and empirical validation.
six_month_return_requirement: A future researcher must be able to distinguish source fact, tooling context, inference, generalized principle, hypothesis, and validated result from this register and the linked Pass 5 records.
